_readme: Skins for the Skin Gallery (skin_test_study.html) and the Terrain Walk. Drop a .glb/.gltf or a Mixamo .fbx (T-pose, With Skin) in this folder, add a line to skins[], refresh. Bone names must be Mixamo's (mixamorig:*), which is what Mixamo exports. Xbot.glb is the standing right-side reference and is loaded separately. Installed 2026-09-01 from Doug's skins_inbox: Eve + two random picks.
